newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up commission, commercial demand.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up commission, commercial demand.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on commission and commercial demand, traders said.

"Commission houses bought outright and the spread, UGG was a buyer, Cargill sold," a trader said. "Soybean oil didn't do anything, so if the USDA report is neutral tomorrow we could be down on profit taking."
March futures crush profit margin rose to -24.74 from -28.27 Monday on CBOT soyoil/meal. Mar-May spread $1.30, May-Nov $35.50, May-July $0.50, Mar-July $1.50.
March canola rose $0.70 to $406.50, May up $0.30 to $405. March flax rose $1.80 to $343.30, May flax up $1.60 to $345.10. Oats and feed peas did not trade.

February western barley lost $1 to $137 on more farmer hedges and Alberta Wheat Pool long liquidation met by commission short covering ahead of Wednesday's USDA supply/demand report, March down $0.70 to $135.80. Volume was 1,633 lots.
March feed wheat fell $0.80 to $169.30, May lost $0.50 to $166 on commission short covering and light hedges. Volume was 210 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats and peas.)
